Who we are

Cloud Energy Photoelectric Limited

We are focused on the conservation of energy and delivering its immediate needs, using inverter systems, solar energy and LED energy-saving lighting for the most efficient use of energy.

Registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission in 2013 and a member of the Nigerian-German Business Association, we back every installation with dedicated engineers and client service representatives.

Awards & Recognition →Our Projects
Our Mission
To provide affordable and reliable alternative energy solutions that create access to solar energy, energy conservation and lighting solutions across Nigeria and Africa.
Our Vision
To be the foremost provider of affordable and reliable alternative energy solutions in Nigeria and Africa.
What we do
Eco-friendly energy solutions for homes and businesses across Nigeria.

Milestones

Our Journey

2013

Company founded and registered with the CAC. Lead carbon and gel batteries, and monocrystalline panels.

2017

Three rural electrification projects in 3 states: one mini grid and two solar home system projects powering 3,000+ homes.

2018

Solar home systems and a range of energy efficiency products.

2019

Lithium ion batteries for energy storage, and solar irrigation for farms.

2023

Second mini grid. Nominated by the Universal Energy Facility.

2024

E-mobility, SSBU, HSSU and ESS, sustainability conversations and Cloud Renewable Gas.

2026

Most Trusted Solar Energy Company of the Year (African Brand Awards); MD named Solar Solution Engineering CEO of the Year (Business Times).
